(Delhi & Uttarakhand), (Punjab & Himachal Pradesh),(Haryana.& Rajasthan)

(Tamil Nadu & Kefala), (Andhra Pradesh& Orissa) & (Kamataka & Goa).

Sub: Review of pro: is for grant of exemption from EDLI Scheme 1976 and
extension thereof under Section 17(2A) of EPF & MP Act, 1952 — reg.

Ref: (I) Co-ord.2 (2)2002/Amend/Pt/4827 dated 14th June 2005.
(li) No. CPFC/Exem/SZ/2005 Vol.11/14750 dated 21-10-2007.

(iii) No. CPFCfExem/SZ/2005 Vol.11/1947 dated 23-5-2008
{iv) CPFC letter No.CPFC/Exemp/SZ/Vol.1V2005/47860 dated 26-03-2009.

Sir,

| am directed to invite a reference to CPFC’s letter dated 16 October 2009
addressed to all the Addl. CPFCs in the States with a request to send a report on the
status of grant of exemption from EDLI Scheme, 1976 under section 17(2A) of the Act upto
the quarter ending September 2009 (SI. No.126 EPFO’s website). In this regard it is
informed that a report is yet to be received from the office of the Addi. CPFCs. The said
report is also to be included in the agenda to be placed before the Sub-committee of the
CBT, EPF on exempted establishments which is scheduled to hold its next meeting on 16”
November 2009 at New Delhi. It is requested that the said report for the quarter ending
September 2009, may kindly be forwarded to this office at the earliest and by 11-11-2009
positively. A soft copy of the report may also be sent by e-mail to the above mentioned e-
mail address.

Yours faithfully,
(Sanjay Bisht)
Regional P.F. Commissioner (Conf).
